texts.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary food. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.GetName]. It is highly addictive, and extremely dangerous. Unscrupulous merchants have been moving absurd quantities of the product at exorbitant prices. As a result, many of the locals are plunging into stupor, and in the worst cases, death.

# 甜牙 / Sweet Tooth

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:9034-9125`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:468, 538-560`（on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl）；`events/on_action_events_2.txt:3146-3179`（action.620/621）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每五年的国家检查运行 action.620：拥有“首次接触”DLC、且与某个前超光速文明有生效协议的普通帝国，会在 0–360 天后抽取“前超光速外交事件池”（无事 200，本事件 10，条件不满足的事件被跳过）。
  The five-year country pulse runs action.620: a regular empire with the First Contact DLC and an active agreement with a pre-FTL civilization draws from the pre-FTL diplomacy pool 0-360 days later (nothing 200, this event 10; events whose conditions fail are skipped).
- 条件：与非“挣脱桎梏”母族的前超光速文明有贸易协议；每个帝国一次。
  Conditions: a trade agreement with a pre-FTL civilization that is not our Broken Shackles parent; once per empire.
- 发生后设置“近期前超光速外交事件”冷却，其他此类事件暂不出现。
  Afterwards a "recent pre-FTL diplomatic event" cooldown blocks the other events of this pool for a while.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 8030「甜牙」：我们出口的普通甜味剂对他们是极易成瘾的精神药物。
  8030 "Sweet Tooth": an ordinary sweetener we export is a dangerously addictive drug for them.
- 选项：禁止贸易并封锁；提供医疗援助；“生意就是生意”（数名当地人会死亡）。单页事件。
  Options: forbid the trade and blockade; provide medical assistance; "business is business" (several natives die). A single window.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 这是可重复抽取的随机外交插曲之一（各事件本身每个帝国通常一次），与同池其他事件没有固定顺序。
  One of the random diplomacy interludes of this pool (each usually once per empire), with no fixed order relative to the others.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 岩石生命时商品改为矿物香料，正文不同。
  For lithoids the commodity is a mineral spice, with a different text.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发与正文条件。
  Checked: trigger and text conditions.
